title: Blue Moon
description:
Bathed in natural light, this residence was conceived to enhance spatial clarity, comfort, and material contrast. The project is guided by a careful approach to responsible and environmentally conscious design choices.

The architectural concept aims to establish a balanced and fluid living environment through a considered selection of durable finishes and textures, chosen for both their aesthetic presence and long-term performance.

The communal areas are articulated by a continuous blue resin floor, conceived as a unifying surface that connects the volumes while reflecting natural light and introducing a subtle contemporary character.

In contrast, the private areas are finished with warm-toned wood flooring sourced from responsible production, reinforcing a sense of intimacy and domestic comfort.

The sanitary spaces incorporate stone finishes, selected for their durability, natural texture, and timeless material quality.
